title: Rav Yissachar Dov Rosenthal
body: Rav Yissachar Dov Rosenthal zt”l, 96, longtime rov of Yerushalayim's Mishkenos Sha’ananim and Nachlaot neighborhoods, passes away after hospitalization. He was niftar on Shabbos morning at Hadassah.

title: Peleg Yerushalmi Protest
body: Peleg Yerushalmi activists block roads near Bnei Brak in protest of young chareidi men's detention for failing to report for military service, with demonstrators halting traffic on Route 4 and Jabotinsky Road.

title: Terror Attack on Chareidi Teacher
body: Rabbi Yaakov Gerber, 37, a chareidi melamed, was wounded in a terror attack. His wife described the harrowing moments, saying the terrorist tried to crush his skull after running him down in Afula and Beit She'an.
